hooks.command: powershell -Command "$timestamp = Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd-HHmm'; $dir = 'docs/session-logs'; if (-not (Test-Path $dir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $dir | Out-Null }; $sessionId = Get-Content env:CLAUDE_SESSION_ID -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if (-not $sessionId) { $sessionId = [guid]::NewGuid().ToString().Substring(0, 8) }; $file = Join-Path $dir \"$timestamp-session.md\"; @\"# Session Export - $timestamp`nSession ID: $sessionId`nClosed: $(Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss')`n\".Trim() | Out-File -FilePath $file -Encoding UTF8 -Append; echo \"Session log created: $file\""
